title: Lemonade Day
description: Run a nimbu pani stand on a Bengaluru street: buy at the mandi, set the recipe and price, ride the weather and festivals, and grow a career. A free browser game.
imageAlt: Lemonade Day season picker with a hand-drawn nimbu pani stand in Bengaluru

title: DevArcade
description: Learn DSA and system design by playing small mobile-first games: Packet City (system design tycoon) and Dungeon of Algorithms (DSA roguelike).
imageAlt: DevArcade skill map showing Packet City and Dungeon of Algorithms

title: Framekar
description: Level up your Reels. A mobile-first web app that teaches short-form video skills through game missions and ends each one with a postable Reel or Short.
imageAlt: Framekar mission screen: Beat Cut Reel, Season 1
